intro: This 10 October 2026 SSC CGL Tier 1 review brings together unofficial candidate reports. The shift cards show section difficulty and recalled topics from the remaining sources. Some reviews have limited evidence and need further corroboration. Exam-wide survey averages are excluded from shift-specific good-attempt estimates; an unavailable total means no reliable recommendation is being made. SSC publishes the official answer key and applies its own score normalisation.

faqs.q: What was the overall difficulty level reported for the 10 October 2026 SSC CGL Tier 1 exam?
faqs.a: Most candidates described the exam as Moderate overall, with the first and third shifts rated Moderate and the second shift rated Easy by the majority of reports.

faqs.q: Which sections were identified as the most challenging on 10 October 2026?
faqs.a: Quantitative Aptitude was frequently cited as the hardest section, especially in Shifts 1 and 3, while English was reported as hard by a single source in Shift 3.

faqs.q: Did candidates experience timing issues during the 10 October 2026 exam?
faqs.a: Yes, candidates across all three shifts mentioned time pressure, particularly because each section had a 15‑minute cut‑off that limited the time available for answering questions.

faqs.q: What was the median score reported for the 10 October 2026 SSC CGL Tier 1 exam?
faqs.a: Shift 2 provided a median mark of approximately 136.5; no median figures were reported for Shifts 1 and 3.

faqs.q: Why are some good-attempt figures unavailable for 10 October 2026?
faqs.a: A pooled survey average, accuracy percentage or conflicting total does not establish how many questions were safe to attempt in a particular shift. Those figures are withheld rather than replaced with guesses.
